description: This PHP class, EntityUniquePropertyOption, provides configuration options for validating the uniqueness of a property within an entity. It includes functionalities for trimming input values, ignoring certain entity instances based on specified values or IDs, and matching specific values for validation purposes.

classes.name: EntityUniquePropertyOption
classes.description: A configuration class for defining rules and options related to ensuring the uniqueness of an entity property during validation. Supports trimming, ignoring specific entity instances, and matching values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the trimming function and sets default ignore values to null.

methods.name: isTrim
methods.description: Returns whether trimming is enabled for input values.

methods.name: setTrim
methods.description: Enables or disables trimming of input values.

methods.name: getTrimFunction
methods.description: Retrieves the Closure used for trimming input values.

methods.name: setTrimFunction
methods.description: Sets a custom Closure as the trimming function.

methods.name: hasIgnoreValues
methods.description: Checks if ignore values have been set.

methods.name: setIgnoreValues
methods.description: Specifies entity values to ignore during validation.

methods.name: getIgnoreValues
methods.description: Returns the array of ignore values.

methods.name: setIgnoreId
methods.description: Adds an ID to the ignore list for validation exclusion.

methods.name: getMatchValues
methods.description: Retrieves the array of match values, if set.

methods.name: hasMatchValues
methods.description: Checks if match values have been set.
